name: Vacation-rental guest ops
description: Anonymous B2B SaaS that automates guest operations for vacation-rental hosts/managers ("Automate guest operations in your vacation rental for $0/month"). Pricing: €12 / property / month plus a 7% fee on guest upsells. Founded Jun 2023, US. Listed for sale at $600k.

mentions.evidence: ~$8,203 MRR, 78 active subscriptions, ~$10,752 L30, ~$218,721 all-time, ~75% L30 profit margin. Asking $600,000. Revenue synced Oct 5, 2026 ~07:39 Warsaw (05:39 UTC). No public domain (stealth).
mentions.indieAngle: Per-unit pricing + take rate on upsells for one rental vertical (Polish mountain apartments, campsites, boat charters). Hook into the PMS/channel manager they already use.

whyItPrints: Short-term-rental ops glue: check-in instructions, guest messaging, upsells (early check-in, late checkout). Per-property pricing scales with portfolio managers, and the upsell take rate adds GMV-linked revenue. 75% L30 margin.
whyThisMatters:
Hosts and managers of vacation rentals get a tool for the guest side of the stay. You can automate that work with no monthly platform fee, then pay a monthly charge per property, plus a cut of what guests spend on extras.

The same jobs come around every stay. Check-in instructions. A message to the guest. An offer for early check-in or late checkout. One property is a small bill. A manager with a bunch of homes pays for each of them. The extra fee only shows up when a guest buys the add-on. Early check-in and late checkout are the paid extras.

There's no public site. The listing is stealth, the company started in the US in June 2023, and the business is for sale.
